<b>Cogworkers</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are flighted [[Cogwork Bugs|automatons]] responsible for repairing and extending the [[Cogwork Core]] in [[the Citadel]].<ref>Cogworker Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Flighted automaton, responsible for repairing and extending the Core."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Cogworkers initially prioritise work and repairs, sometimes flying to another place where they continue their work. During this, they ignore Hornet, but still deal {{Damage|1}} on contact. Upon striking them however, they begin to pursue Hornet over any distance, and any nearby Cogworkers also begin targeting Hornet.
Once they are in range, they move forwards slightly and slash all around themselves in a small area, comboing Hornet for {{Damage|1+1}} if she is hit by it at any point during the attack animation. After this, they fly backwards a short distance to retreat before their next attack.

Ranged and charged attacks can take them down quickly without getting too close. Counterattacking during their attacks is also effective, due to their short range and inability to move whilst slashing.

== Location ==
Cogworkers can be found in the [[Choral Chambers]] and the [[Cogwork Core]]. Two of them appear to repair a [[Cogwork Clapper]] after it is defeated in the lower eastern Cogwork Core, completing their work and departing only when Hornet rests at a [[Bench (Silksong)|bench]] outside the area. This cycle repeats every time the Cogwork Clapper is destroyed, unless the repair is disrupted by knocking its partially reconstructed shell into the pit of active cogs, or until [[Act 3]] begins.

== Trivia ==
* When singing, Cogworkers produce the same chirping sounds as [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]]'s and [[Maestro]]'s Cogflies.
* In the <i>Silksong</i> reveal trailer, Cogworkers had a different behaviour, being stationary and passive to be used for traversal with the [[Clawline]], similiarly to [[Driftlin]]s.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pFAknD_9U7c Hollow Knight: Silksong Reveal Trailer]</ref>
